final:
STATUS: pass

SUMMARY: I found no reproduced blocking failure against the acceptance criteria. Overflow, contrast, focus rings, the mobile menu, filter URL state, events time zones, form validation and file:// all held in headless Chromium. The suite's main gap is that nothing asserts text contrast; a deliberately low-contrast blurb passes all 31 tests. The site's own text contrast does meet AA.

FILES TOUCHED: none (probes and mutated copies live in the scratchpad; `git status` is unchanged, same 13 "A" entries).

FINDINGS:
- [minor] tests/run.mjs does not assert body text contrast. Mutation: `.book-blurb { color: #b9b2a6 }` (about 2:1 on the card) gives "31 passed, 0 failed". The m7 `--ink` mutation was only caught by the focus-ring test, because it also changed the header background.
- [minor] CHECKS line is stale: the suite has 31 tests and all 31 pass in my copy, not 28.
- [minor] Without JavaScript: books.html shows 0 books and no count; events.html and index.html show no events and the events-empty message is hidden; at 360 the Menu button shows and does nothing. The no-JS form submit navigates to `visit.html?name=Ada&...&message=secret+text+here`, with no demo notice. The spec does not require no-JS, so this is a judgement call.
- [minor] `#form-status` is an empty tinted box on load (24px tall, background rgb(236,226,207), left border), which looks like a notice.
- [minor] Menu stays open after an outside click (`aria-expanded` stays `true`). Escape always moves focus to the toggle, even when focus was elsewhere.
- [minor] The empty-state branch is never exercised: no test forces zero matches. `books-empty-state-message-exists` checks only that the wording exists and is hidden.
- [minor] Arrow keys on the genre radios each push a history entry (ArrowDown from All added `?genre=mystery`), so Back takes many presses.
- [minor] Layout: at 1280 the header splits into two rows, and book cards in a row end at uneven heights (screenshot).
- [minor] Mailto with a 6000-character message is an 8,793-character href; not reproduced as a failure in the browser.
- [minor] Email regex accepts `a@-b.c`. Phone and email are hard-coded in visit.html as well as in data.js, so they can drift.

CHECKS:
- Overflow sweep at 320, 340, 375, 414, 600, 719, 720, 768, 900, 1024, 1280 and 1440 on all four pages → pass (no sideways scroll). A 400-char unbroken word at 320 → pass (scrollWidth 320). A 5000-char genre at 360 → pass. Hours table at 320 → pass (right edge 304).
- In-page WCAG check on every text node on four pages → pass. Focus-ring check on every Tab stop at 1280 and at 360 with the menu open → pass.
- Menu at 360, keyboard only: Skip → Brand → Menu; Enter opens; Tab reaches Home/Books/Events/Visit; Escape closes and returns focus to the toggle → pass.
- Filter URL: `?genre=MYSTERY`, `%20mystery%20`, `Science%20Fiction`, `Young%20Readers`, empty, unknown, `<script>`, `onerror` payload, emoji, 5000 chars → pass (fallback to All, no dialogs, no errors). Five back and five forward steps → pass.
- Events, local time: LA and Kiritimati midnight on 21 Nov, Pago Pago 23:59, Kiritimati 23:59 on 20 Nov, LA 14 Feb 2027 00:01 → pass (empty message on 14 Feb; home message on 1 Mar 2027 visible).
- Form: whitespace, `a@`, `foo`, `a@b`, `a@@b.co`, `@b.co` rejected with focus on the invalid field; Enter, triple submit, HTML in fields, mailto encoding → pass.
- file:// (catalogue, filter with pushState and back, events, form) → pass, no non-file requests.
- Mutations: UTC midnight, aria-describedby removed, "Thanks, sent" text, popstate removed, skip link removed, Google Fonts link, 500px box, aria-current removed, dead nav link, footer drift → each caught by the suite (fail as expected).

OPEN QUESTIONS: Is no-JS operation in scope? If yes, the catalogue, events and home need server-side or static fallback content. Should the suite gain a text-contrast assertion (it's the only criterion with no test)?
